import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    target = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()

    if target.empty:
        target = pd.DataFrame(columns=["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"])

    # Attach each device's current watermark (applied_event_ts) to every event.
    merged = cdc.merge(
        target[["device_id", "applied_event_ts"]],
        on="device_id",
        how="left",
        suffixes=("", "_wm"),
    )

    # Survival rule:
    #   - device unknown to target (no watermark) -> event survives
    #   - event_ts strictly greater than watermark -> event survives
    #   - event_ts == watermark (replay) or < watermark (late) -> discarded
    survive_mask = merged["applied_event_ts"].isna() | (
        merged["event_ts"] > merged["applied_event_ts"]
    )
    survivors = merged.loc[survive_mask].copy()

    if not survivors.empty:
        # Pick the winner per device: max by (event_ts, event_seq)
        survivors_sorted = survivors.sort_values(
            by=["device_id", "event_ts", "event_seq"],
            ascending=[True, False, False],
        )
        winners = survivors_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset="device_id", keep="first")
        winners = winners[["device_id", "reading", "event_ts"]].rename(
            columns={"event_ts": "applied_event_ts"}
        )
    else:
        winners = pd.DataFrame(columns=["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"])

    # Base result starts as a carry-forward of the existing snapshot.
    result = target.set_index("device_id")
    winners_idx = winners.set_index("device_id")

    # Update devices that have a winning event (overwrite reading + watermark).
    if not winners_idx.empty:
        common_cols = ["reading", "applied_event_ts"]
        result.update(winners_idx[common_cols])

        # Add brand-new devices that weren't present in target_snapshot.
        new_devices = winners_idx.loc[~winners_idx.index.isin(result.index)]
        if not new_devices.empty:
            result = pd.concat([result, new_devices[common_cols]], axis=0)

    result = result.reset_index()[["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"]]

    return {"new_snapshot": result}
